segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, so Northstar is still at 68 seats for phase one, with 12 more penciled in for October. They want the services line split out on the order form, $7,400, because procurement tracks that separate.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Got it. Are they still asking for the September 3 go-live, or did they move that after the admin training note?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Still September 3. The only thing, I'm still pinging legal for the data addendum sign-off; Northstar won't countersign until that lands, so the order's just sitting right now.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Okay. On pricing, I saw 18 percent in the CRM. Is that the final, or are we holding at 15?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Eighteen is what we talked through with Dan. I've nudged deal desk twice for the discount approval, because I can't send the final quote without it and they're waiting on that version to open the PO.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Makes sense. Billing-wise, they asked for net 45 and annual upfront, right?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yep, annual upfront, $52,680 software, plus the services line. Also, can you help push finance on the tax treatment for the Canadian subsidiary? I asked Monday and again this morning; procurement won't release the PO until they get that answer.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Yeah, I'll send a note after this. Anything weird in the terms, auto-renewal or termination?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Nothing weird. One-year initial term, auto-renewal at 12 months, 30-day notice. They accepted the uptime language after we clarified the maintenance window.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Cool. Once those pieces come back, you should be able to get it into signature today?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: That's the plan. I already have the order form drafted in the CRM, just need to swap in the final quote and attach the addendum before I send.
